title: Plan: Add .gitignore and Initial Commit
body:
# Plan: Add .gitignore and Initial Commit

- Confidence: 95%
- Version: v1.0

## Documents

- Truth: /workspace/01_excel_dashboard/ (current directory state)
- References: None
- Targets:
  - /workspace/01_excel_dashboard/.gitignore (new file)
  - Git repository (first commit will be added)
- Dependencies:
  - v5.5_40L_Project_Tracker.xlsm (existing project file - to be committed)
  - .IDE_Plans/ (to be ignored, not committed)
- Tests: None (no test infrastructure exists)

## Goal

1. Create `.gitignore` that excludes `.IDE_Plans/`
2. Make the first commit with `.gitignore` and `v5.5_40L_Project_Tracker.xlsm`
3. `.IDE_Plans/` must remain untracked after the commit

## Change Items

### Change 1 - Create .gitignore

- Type: CREATE
- File: /workspace/01_excel_dashboard/.gitignore
- FROM: (does not exist)
- TO:
  ```
  .IDE_Plans/
  ```
- Reason: User wants to exclude .IDE_Plans/ from version control
- Status: DONE

### Change 2 - Stage files for commit

- Type: BASH (git add)
- File: git index
- FROM: working tree has .gitignore (untracked), v5.5_40L_Project_Tracker.xlsm (untracked), .IDE_Plans/ (untracked)
- TO: .gitignore and v5.5_40L_Project_Tracker.xlsm staged; .IDE_Plans/ remains untracked
- Reason: Prepare files for first commit
- Status: DONE

### Change 3 - Create first commit

- Type: BASH (git commit)
- File: git repository
- FROM: no commits yet
- TO: first commit with message "initial commit" (commit hash 4c82c01)
- Reason: User requested commit
- Status: DONE

## Notes

- Git user.name and user.email are already configured (Adi-Mudi / 288925325+Adi-Mudi@users.noreply.github.com)
- After this plan, git status should show a clean working tree (no untracked files except .IDE_Plans/ which is ignored)

## Retrospective

- What went well: .gitignore created, .IDE_Plans/ properly ignored, first commit landed cleanly
- What failed: Nothing
- What to improve next time: Could batch these into one tool call to be more efficient
